mapper.sql: act_idx, store_idx, act_type, act_dt, CAST(create_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS create_dt, act_notes, memo_txt, sv_id, appr_id, appr_status, CAST(appr_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS appr_dt, suggestions, sv_notes, appr_notes, r_chk_id, chk_yn
mapper.select:
SELECT '' AS store_nm, um.user_name AS user_name, um.user_id AS user_id, am.act_dt AS act_dt, COUNT(DISTINCT am.store_idx) AS cnt FROM user_mst um LEFT OUTER JOIN active_mst am ON um.user_id = am.appr_id AND (am.appr_status = 'PENDING' OR am.appr_status = 'APPROVED') AND am.act_dt BETWEEN #{startDt} AND #{endDt} WHERE um.sv_yn = 'Y'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_mst sm WHERE sm.brand_cd = #{brandCd})
GROUP BY um.user_id, am.act_dt, um.user_name ORDER BY um.user_id, am.act_dt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chk_result_dtl (act_idx, chk_idx, answer_val, answer_score) VALUES (#{actIdx}, #{chkIdx}, #{answerVal}, #{answerScore})
mapper.select: SELECT um.user_name AS user_name, dm.dept_nm AS dept_nm FROM user_mst um LEFT JOIN dept_mst dm ON um.dept_idx = dm.dept_idx WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_name FROM user_mst WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT CM.chk_idx AS chk_idx, CM.brand_cd AS brand_cd, CM.chk_type AS chk_type, COD.code_nm AS chk_type_nm, CM.chk_content AS chk_content, COALESCE(CM.base_score, 0) AS base_score, CM.display_order AS display_order, COALESCE(CRD.answer_val, '미평가') AS answer_val, COALESCE(CRD.answer_score, 0) AS answer_score FROM chk_mst CM LEFT OUTER JOIN chk_result_dtl CRD ON CM.chk_idx = CRD.chk_idx AND CRD.act_idx = #{actIdx} INNER JOIN code_mst COD ON CM.chk_type = COD.code_cd AND COD.grp_cd = '50' INNER JOIN active_mst ACT ON ACT.act_idx = #{actIdx} INNER JOIN store_mst SM ON SM.store_idx = ACT.store_idx WHERE CM.brand_cd = SM.brand_cd ORDER BY CM.display_order, CM.chk_idx
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chk_mst (brand_cd, chk_type, chk_content, base_score, use_yn, display_order) VALUES (#{brandCd}, #{chkType}, #{chkContent}, #{baseScore}, 'Y', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(display_order) + 1 FROM chk_mst), 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE chk_mst SET brand_cd = #{brandCd}, chk_type = #{chkType}, chk_content = #{chkContent}, base_score = #{baseScore}, use_yn = #{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE chk_idx = #{chkIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT c.chk_idx, c.brand_cd, c.chk_type, COALESCE(cm.code_nm, c.chk_type) AS chk_type_nm, c.chk_content, c.base_score, c.use_yn, c.display_order FROM chk_mst c LEFT JOIN code_mst cm ON cm.grp_cd = '50' AND cm.code_cd = c.chk_type WHERE c.chk_idx = #{chkIdx}

SELECT
FROM active_mst WHERE appr_status != 'DRAFT' ORDER BY create_dt DESC, act_idx DESC

SELECT
FROM active_mst WHERE appr_status = #{apprStatus} ORDER BY create_dt DESC, act_idx DESC

SELECT
FROM active_mst WHERE store_idx = #{storeIdx} ORDER BY act_dt DESC, act_idx DESC

SELECT
FROM active_mst WHERE chk_yn = #{chkYn, jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY create_dt DESC, act_idx DESC

SELECT
FROM active_mst WHERE sv_id = #{svId} AND appr_notes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY create_dt DESC, act_idx DESC

SELECT notif_idx, user_id, msg_txt, notif_typ, act_idx, appr_yn, CAST(read_yn AS VARCHAR) AS read_yn, CAST(create_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS create_dt FROM notif_mst WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_dt DESC, notif_idx DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notif_mst WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_yn = 'N'
